name: 劉宇晨
objective:
本課程介紹電力電子轉換器之基本原理、分析方法與應用。課程內容包含功率半導體元件、基本 DC - DC 轉換器、CCM/DCM 分析、損耗與效率估算、整流器與功率因數校正、隔離型轉換器、諧振式轉換器、逆變器，以及電力電子控制基礎。學生將學習以伏秒平衡、電荷平衡、元件應力分析與波形分析理解各類轉換器之工作原理，並建立電力電子系統設計與應用的基礎能力。

This course introduces the fundamental principles, analysis methods, and applications of power electronic converters. Topics include power semiconductor devices, basic DC - DC converters, CCM/DCM operation, loss and efficiency estimation, rectifiers and power factor correction, isolated converters, resonant converters, inverters, and basic control concepts for power electronics. Students will learn converter operation through volt-second balance, charge balance, device stress analysis, and waveform analysis, developing essential skills for power electronics system design and applications.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1	Introduction to Power Electronics and Converter Systems
Week 2	Power Semiconductor Devices: Diodes, MOSFETs, IGBTs, SiC/GaN Devices
Week 3	Review of Circuit Fundamentals and Magnetic Components
Week 4	Buck Converter: Operation Principle and CCM Analysis
Week 5	Boost Converter: Operation Principle and CCM Analysis
Week 6	Buck-Boost Converter and Other Basic DC-DC Topologies
Week 7	Discontinuous Conduction Mode, DCM, and CCM/DCM Boundary
Week 8	Loss Analysis and Efficiency Estimation
Week 9	Midterm Exam
Week 10	AC-DC Rectifiers and Input Current Characteristics
Week 11	Power Factor Correction, PFC, Fundamentals
Week 12	Isolated DC-DC Converters I: Flyback and Forward Converters
Week 13	Isolated DC-DC Converters II: Push-Pull, Half-Bridge, and Full-Bridge Converters
Week 14	Resonant Converters and Soft-Switching Concepts
Week 15	DC-AC Inverters and PWM Modulation
Week 16	Basic Control Concepts for Power Electronics
Week 17	Power Electronics System Design and Application Case Studies
Week 18	Final Exam
